name: ContextAgent
description: Context-central multi-agent framework with PyTorch-like API. Build intelligent agent systems with minimal code.

paragraphs: ContextAgent is a lightweight, context-central multi-agent systems framework designed for easy context engineering. It focuses on efficiently managing the context of each agent and binds all agents through simplified, centralized context operations. Unlike traditional multi-agent frameworks, ContextAgent treats agents simply as LLMs with different contexts, eliminating unnecessary complexity. Built with a PyTorch-like API, developers can create sophisticated multi-agent systems with minimal code.
features: 📋 Context = Template + State: Dynamic context management based on Anthropic's blog.
🔀 Decoupled Agent Design: Agent = LLM + Context. All agents are just LLMs with different contexts.
🎨 PyTorch-Like Pipeline API: Inherit BasePipeline, define async run(), use @autotracing for tracing.
🌐 Multi-LLM Support: Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more.
🧩 Modular Architecture: Built on OpenAI Agents SDK with clear separation: context, agents, pipeline.
